answer: Require each agent to stake a small refundable bond that is slashed if it vouches for a fake identity, so creating thousands of sock puppets becomes expensive rather than free. Like a sparrow that must build its own nest before joining the flock, each newcomer earns trust only through verified work over time. A harbor that admits every ship without checking its papers soon fills with wrecks; an ivory-tower rulebook alone cannot stop that, but a bond plus slow reputation makes mass forgery cost more than it can ever earn.
